trust_decision.summary: The fix decides that every plugin identifier that is concatenated into the plugin directory path, passed to Plugin::install()/Plugin::uninstall(), or used as the extractTo() target must match /\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\z/ after trim() and an is_string() test, and that an uploaded archive may contain no absolute, drive-letter, '..', NUL or symlink entry; the decision is enforced in the app-store plugin service and the store controller is additionally put behind the admin permission gate.

landing_point.why: The advisory names 'Plugin Install/Uninstall', so a reader goes straight to install()/unInstall(); the sibling route download() sits 18 lines above in the same class and uploadLocalApp() 65 lines below.

fix_sites.module_kind: plugin service method, archive upload/zip-slip path

fix_sites.entry_point: reached from all four actions above
fix_sites.module_kind: new private validators added by the fix (normalizeIdentifier, assertSafeZipEntries, isUnsafeZipEntryName, isZipEntrySymlink); no such helper exists at the pinned commit
HTTP controller, authorisation gate (separate weakness from the traversal)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The whole store surface is a development-only feature (config/autoload/mine-extension.php:20 enable = APP_DEBUG, ConfigProvider.php:20 returns no annotation path when not in debug, front end web/src/plugins/mine-admin/app-store/index.ts:17 enable = import.meta.env.DEV), so any route beyond the four actions named in the advisory can be argued to be outside the shipped product.
O6_input_shapes: plain string identifier in 'vendor/name' form (e.g. mine-admin/app-store, plugin/mine-admin/app-store/mine.json:2)
identifier with surrounding whitespace -> trim() before matching
zip entry names: absolute (/x), drive-letter (C:/x), backslash separators, '..' segments, NUL bytes, empty names
zip entries that are Unix symlinks via getExternalAttributesIndex high bits 0xA000
the 'name' field inside the archive's mine.json, which becomes the extractTo() directory
archive with no mine.json at all (getFromName returns false)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a further plugin-lifecycle action (remove/delete local app, or 'upgrade') that builds Plugin::PLUGIN_PATH . '/' . identifier and calls Plugin::uninstall()/unlink without normalizeIdentifier
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The controller already exposes four plugin-lifecycle actions with an identical request shape (identifier + version, $this->request->all()); a maintainer extends this controller, not the vendor Plugin class, and would copy the neighbouring line.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'refresh/upgrade all installed plugins' method that iterates the names produced by Plugin::read()/getPluginJsonPaths() and calls Plugin::install($info['name']) - the identifier comes from mine.json on disk, not from the request
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getLocalAppInstallList already consumes those names and the UI keys install state by them (web/src/plugins/mine-admin/app-store/views/localList.vue:36-39, list.vue:45), so a batch reinstall path is a natural next commit, and a request-parameter whitelist never sees those names.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal (plugin identifier path traversal; same commit also fixes archive zip-slip)

O10_build.language: PHP 8.1+ (Hyperf 3.1 on Swoole 5) with a TypeScript/pnpm front end
O10_build.toolchain: composer install; pnpm/npm for web/; co-phpunit for tests (composer.json:116-123); php-cs-fixer/phpstan
services: remote MineAdmin store for the download route (Service.php:33)
O10_build.project_tests: co-phpunit feature suite under tests/Feature with MySQL migrations (tests/HttpTestCase.php, .github/ci/run.test.sh); no test at the pinned commit exercises the app-store plugin or admin/plugin/store routes

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip '..' from the identifier (str_replace/basename) inside install() and unInstall() only, leaving download(), the uploaded mine.json name and the zip entries untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The same fix commit also adds a missing authorisation gate (PermissionMiddleware + #[Permission('plugin:store')]) to the store controller - an access-control weakness, not the CWE-22 traversal screened here; not pursued.
unverified: vendor/ is gitignored (.gitignore:8) and absent from the pinned tree, so the sink itself (Mine\AppStore\Plugin::install/uninstall, Mine\AppStore\Service\Impl\AppStoreServiceImpl::download) and the composer/pnpm invocation inside install are not readable; whether those methods validate names on their own is unknown.

The fix references Plugin::PLUGIN_PATH, a constant defined nowhere in the pinned tree; it only resolves after composer install fetches mineadmin/app-store (composer.json:60), and no composer.lock is tracked (.gitignore:22).

The console entries mine-extension:download / mine-extension:install, shown to users with a raw identifier at web/src/plugins/mine-admin/app-store/views/detail.vue:82-85, reach the same Plugin::install sink from argv; the handler lives in the vendor package, so whether the fix covers it cannot be checked, and it is not counted in O8 (it is not code in this repository).
Repo size in MB not measured (no shell access); the pinned tree has 567 files, so tiny_repo/giant_repo could not be decided.

Whether a hidden test can assert the 'legitimate identifier still works' control offline is unknown: that path runs Plugin::install, which per config/autoload/mine-extension.php:32-60 drives composer and pnpm.
No latest release was supplied, so present_in_latest for any route would be unknown.
